periods.time: After Bell's Guild level-up report, before Hestia updates his status

name.zh: 贝尔向埃伊娜咨询发展能力
name.en: Bell Consults Eina on Development Abilities

periods.summary: After Eina apologizes for revealing Bell's level-up, Bell explains that he fought the 9th-floor Minotaur alone and asks for advice about his possible development abilities: Abnormal Resistance, Hunter, and the unknown rare ability Luck.
periods.cause: Bell has reached the point of choosing a development ability, and Hestia told him to ask Eina for a professional opinion before finalizing his Lv.2 status.
periods.process: Eina first reprimands Bell for risking death against the Minotaur, then congratulates him and frames the ability choice by Bell's long-term goal. She says Hunter suits steady dungeon progress, while Luck may help if his goal lies beyond ordinary strength.
periods.outcome: Bell decides to trust Eina's framing and chooses Luck after returning to Hestia.
periods.aftermath: Eina resolves not to report the unprecedented Luck ability to Guild leadership to avoid drawing more attention to Bell.
periods.significance: This scene establishes Bell's first development ability choice and Eina's ongoing role as a protective advisor rather than just a Guild clerk.
